name: BitCrown distributor missing caller authorization
summary: The stateless distributor let any caller choose a token, recipients and amounts for transfers from its own balance. The attacker removed its entire 100,000 BTCn inventory and sold it for USDT.
notes: Entire BTCn inventory valued at actual same-transaction disposal proceeds: 7939.270661176575393032 USDT at par. The token transfer deduction and swap price impact are reflected in the effective value of the stolen 100000 BTCn; gas and recoveries do not reduce gross loss.
